UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account root document anchoring per-device dynasty saves.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the account owner.

email.description: Verified Google account email (strictly isolated to owner).

displayName.description: Player display name shown in local title bar.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user root record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile sync.

DeviceDynastySave.title: DeviceDynastySave
DeviceDynastySave.description: Online dynasty save scoped to a player's specific device using native Firestore maps and lists.

ownerUid.description: Immutable UID of the authenticated player owning this save.

deviceId.description: Immutable device identifier generated and persisted on the player's browser/device.

rings.description: Championship rings won in this dynasty.

careerData.description: Structured native Firestore map containing roster, leagueRosters, standings, schedule, weekGames, playoffs, freeAgents, draftClass, and history.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this device save was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this device save was last updated.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Server-managed teacher admin marker allowing additional co-teachers to publish Algebra review topics.

uid.description: Firebase UID of the authorized teacher admin.

role.description: Role label for the admin record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

ReviewTopic.title: ReviewTopic
ReviewTopic.description: Curated, deduplicated Algebra review topic with student-friendly title, unit grouping, standards metadata, and multiple-choice questions synced by the teacher.

ownerUid.description: Immutable UID of the verified teacher who published this topic.

unitOrder.description: Curriculum sequence order for the unit (1-99).

topicTitle.description: Student-friendly topic title translated from curriculum standards.

studentSummary.description: Short plain-English summary shown in the student topic picker.

standards.description: Bounded list of curriculum standard codes or labels merged into this topic (max 25).

questions.description: Bounded list of deduplicated multiple-choice review questions (1-50).

isPublished.description: Whether students can select and play this topic without signing in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this topic was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this topic was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private player profile root documents, strictly accessible only by the matching verified owner.

/users/{userId}/deviceSaves/{deviceId}.description: Online dynasty saves anchored beneath each verified player's user document (uses shared 'activeCareer' ID for cross-device sync).

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only teacher admin records for co-teacher authorization.

/reviewTopics/{topicId}.description: Published Algebra review topics and question banks readable by students and manageable only by verified teacher admins.
